social_circle.name: Elena Denis

demographics.education: some college and medical office certificate

background.how_they_met: They grew up together in their Honduran American family in South Dallas, sharing a room as children.
background.why_close: Elena is Catherine's closest family member. They share caregiving history, Catholic and Honduran family traditions, concern about health, and the habit of checking in privately rather than posting online.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in full sentences, often mixing English and Spanish. She sends quick check-ins, appointment reminders, family updates, and occasional voice notes when a story is too long to type.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating their next Sunday lunch and whether Elena should come by while Catherine is baking sourdough.
Elena's arthritis and blood sugar concerns, including reminders to keep appointments.
Careful discussion of politics, race, and church conversations without letting family meals turn into arguments.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Catherine's closest family is her younger sister Elena in Irving and that they talk almost every evening around 7:30. Q13 says Elena visits every other Sunday or a Saturday afternoon. Q35 says Catherine tracks Elena's arthritis and blood sugar concerns.

social_circle.name: Janice Walker

background.how_they_met: They met through Catherine's Wednesday evening Catholic church study group.
background.why_close: They share a quiet faith life, love of books, preference for low-drama friendship, and steady routines. Janice is one of the few people Catherine contacts directly when she needs emotional support.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses complete sentences and gentle humor. She sends book recommendations, prayer requests, and short reflective texts, rarely using emojis beyond a simple heart or folded-hands symbol.

recent_text_topics: Choosing the next book to trade after church study.
Planning a quiet coffee outing near Bishop Arts.
Checking on Catherine after the stressful work period when Catherine began delegating more to Tasha.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 identifies Janice as Catherine's closest friend from church study and says they sit together on Wednesday evenings, trade books, meet monthly for coffee, and sometimes go to used bookstores. Q44 says Catherine told Janice about a difficult work week. Q49 says Catherine calls Janice directly for support.

social_circle.name: Marisol Reyes
social_circle.relationship: cousin and Honduran community volunteer partner

background.how_they_met: They are cousins through Catherine's Honduran family network and became especially close through church and Honduran community food distribution work.
background.why_close: They share Honduran heritage, Spanish language, Catholic parish life, food-as-care values, and recurring volunteer responsibilities.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts quickly and practically, often in Spanglish. She sends logistics, names, quantities, and reminders, then adds warm family comments after the practical details are handled.

shared_activities: coordinating food boxes and prepared items
recent_text_topics: Coordinating tables, volunteers, and food safety details for the next church food distribution.
Planning who will bring Honduran ingredients or prepared dishes for a community gathering.
Checking whether older parish members need boxes carried to their cars.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Catherine is close to her cousin Marisol, who helps organize Honduran community food distributions. Q17 says Catherine volunteers once or twice a month with food distribution through church and the Honduran community network. Q47 says Janice and Marisol are among the people Catherine is closest to at church.

social_circle.name: Patrice Johnson
social_circle.relationship: walking companion from River City Walking Club

demographics.education: high school diploma and administrative certificate

background.how_they_met: They met through the River City Walking Club and began walking the same early-morning route.
background.why_close: Their bond is built on repeated presence, health routines, neighborhood familiarity, and the dependable rhythm of weekday walks.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short, practical messages early in the morning: weather, route changes, who is running late, and reminders to bring water. Uses occasional emojis and exclamation points.

shared_activities: weekday morning walks from about 6:15 to 6:45
recent_text_topics: Whether Dallas heat means shortening the morning walk route.
Checking if Catherine's knees are stiff after longer workdays.
Confirming walk times when rain or storms are expected.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Catherine walks most mornings with Patrice and Linda from the River City Walking Club, usually five mornings a week if weather cooperates. Q09 says Catherine walks early in the morning with the walking club. Q32 notes Dallas heat makes summer walking harder.

social_circle.name: Linda Tran
social_circle.relationship: walking companion from River City Walking Club

background.how_they_met: They met through the River City Walking Club as part of Catherine's regular morning walking routine.
background.why_close: Linda and Catherine are not described as intimate friends, but they have frequent contact because they walk together most mornings and keep each other accountable.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts brief and conversationally, with mild teasing about weather, sore knees, or who is bringing too much energy before sunrise. Uses more emojis than Catherine does.

shared_activities: regular River City Walking Club walks
recent_text_topics: Morning walk confirmations and whether the group should avoid especially hot days.
Linda asking about Catherine's garden tomatoes and basil.
Light joking about Catherine being too disciplined with lists before breakfast.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Linda as one of the two women Catherine walks with most mornings through the River City Walking Club. Q17 describes Catherine's garden with tomatoes, peppers, basil, rosemary, and squash, making produce-related texts plausible. Q18 says morning walks improved Catherine's mood.
